hero.description: MVP Studio brings your agencies, projects and tasks together in one elegant dashboard. Follow every mission, lead every team — simply.

features.title: Everything you need to run your projects
features.subtitle: A complete tool, built for agencies and teams that want to move fast and do it right.

multiAgency.title: Multi-agency
multiAgency.description: Manage several agencies from a single account, with clear navigation between each of them.

projects.title: Project management
projects.description: Create projects, track their progress and keep an overview of all your missions.

tasks.title: Task tracking
tasks.description: Organize your tasks by status, priority or member. Nothing slips through the cracks.

team.title: Team management
team.description: Invite your colleagues, define roles and see everyone's activity.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Stay informed about new tasks, comments and important changes in real time.

settings.title: Advanced settings
settings.description: Customize your agencies, manage permissions and adapt the tool to the way you work.

howItWorks.title: Get started in three simple steps
howItWorks.subtitle: From creating your agency to collaborating as a team, you're up and running in minutes.

createAgency.title: Create your agency
createAgency.description: Create your agency in a few seconds. Generate an invitation link to add your colleagues and start structuring your organization.

organizeProjects.title: Organize your projects
organizeProjects.description: Create projects by client or by mission. Break them down into clear tasks, set priorities and keep an overview of every milestone.

collaborate.title: Collaborate as a team
collaborate.description: Assign tasks to your members, follow notifications, and manage the activity of the whole agency from a single, simple dashboard.

testimonials.title: They use MVP Studio every day
testimonials.subtitle: Our customers successfully manage their agencies, projects and teams.

amina.quote: MVP Studio has transformed the way we work. All our agencies and projects are finally centralized in one place.

karim.quote: Task tracking is crystal clear. Every team member knows exactly what to do and where each project stands.

leila.quote: Simple, fast and effective. Huge time saver.

youssef.quote: The overview we finally have of all our projects. The dashboard is clear, the notifications are relevant.

finalCta.title: Ready to <highlight>level up</highlight>?
finalCta.description: Join hundreds of teams who organize their agencies, projects and tasks with MVP Studio. It's free to get started.

footer.description: The all-in-one platform to manage your agencies, projects and teams, simply and efficiently.
